args:
case "${BIFF_RELAY_TOKEN:-}" in ''|'${'*) unset BIFF_RELAY_TOKEN ;; esac
if [ -z "${CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID:-}" ]; then
  if [ -r /proc/sys/kernel/random/uuid ]; then
    read -r CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID < /proc/sys/kernel/random/uuid
  else
    CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID="devin-$(date +%s)-$$"
  fi
  export CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID
fi
for repo in "${DEVIN_PROJECT_DIR:-}" "$HOME/repos/punt-labs" "$HOME"/repos/*; do
  [ -n "$repo" ] && [ -e "$repo/.git" ] || continue
  cd "$repo" || continue
  if biff version 2>/dev/null | awk '$1 == "biff" { split($2, v, "."); if (v[1] + 0 > 1 || (v[1] + 0 == 1 && v[2] + 0 >= 23)) ok = 1 } END { exit !ok }'; then
    exec biff mcp --user devin
  elif command -v uvx >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    exec uvx --from 'punt-biff>=1.23.0' biff mcp --user devin
  elif command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    exec uv tool run --from 'punt-biff>=1.23.0' biff mcp --user devin
  else
    exec biff mcp --user devin
  fi
done
printf '%s\n' 'biff: no git repository found' >&2
exit 1
